Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a '''''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ship''' served in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and was used to blockade the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]]. [[Sib Canay/Legends|Sib Canay]], owner of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]], conspired with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and hired the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and his [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] accomplice to kidnap [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida's]] two daughters in order to coerce him into aligning Pantora with the Separatists.
